senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צדד to join; cmp. סַד) side, border.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 11a:8">B. Mets. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>עומד בצד שדהו</he> he was standing at the border of his field.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:2">Snh. IV, 2</cite> in capital cases <he>מתחילין מן הצד</he> they begin to take the votes from the side bench (the junior judges), opp. <he>הגדול</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 36a:5-6">Ib. 36ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>כולהו … מן הצד הוו מתחלי</he> they began all their voting with the youngest; <cite ref="Gittin 59a">Gitt. 59ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:9">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>בצִדָּהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02149"><he>פִּתְחוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 74b:2">Kidd. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>מצידה</he> (Var. in Ar. s. v. <cite ref="R00078"><he>צד</he></cite>: <he>מצמדה</he>), v. <cite ref="V00072"><he>תַּבְרָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63a:11">B. Mets. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>צד אחד בריבית</he>, v. <cite ref="T00111"><he>רִבִּית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1">B. Kam. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>הצד השוה שבהן</he> the points common to both, v. <cite ref="E00857"><he>הֲרֵי</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 78a:14">Kidd. 78ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מה להצד השוה וכ׳</he> what is the common point? <cite ref="Kiddushin 78a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>ומייתי לה במה הצד</he> and proves it by analogy from the common point.

<cite ref="Berakhot 35a:13">Ber. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>מה להצד … שכן יש בו צד מזבח</he> what is the common point? that it may eventually be used for the altar?; <he>ואתי נמי זית … צד מזבח</he> and so is ‘olive’ included, which is eventually used on the altar (as oil).
B. Mets. 115ᵃ לצד שני another interpretation.—מן הצד sideways, in an unusual manner, indirectly.

<cite ref="Shabbat 47b:2">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>בנין מן הצד</he> an indirect way of building (putting up a folding bed); a. fr.—<he>כאיזה צד</he>, <he>כאי זה צד</he>, <he>כיזה צד</he>, v. <cite ref="K00616"><he>כֵּיצַד</he></cite>.—Pl. v. <cite ref="R00085"><he>צְדָד</he></cite>
